issue_context.title: table borders
issue_context.body: [ffpdfjs_bug_tablelines.pdf](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/files/2875821/ffpdfjs_bug_tablelines.pdf) Configuration: - Web browser and its version: Firefox Quantum 65.0 (64 bits) - Operating system and its version: macOS Mojave 10.14.3 - PDF.js version: - Is a browser extension: Steps to reproduce the problem: 1. open attached pdf in firefox (drag and drop in new tab) 2. the rendering of the borders in the table changes with the level of zoom What is the expected behavior? (add screenshot) expected behavior (from preview/or google chrome) What went wrong? (add screenshot) ![screenshot_2019-02-18 ffpdfjs_bug_tablelines pdf](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22364279/52955197-5d951480-338c-11e9-8be6-565960b6da2e.png) This pdf was modified for anonymisation reasons. But you can find this in the metadata of the original file : ``` File Permissions : rw-r--r-- File Type : PDF File Type Extension : pdf MIME Type : application/pdf PDF Version : 1.6 Linearized : No Encryption : Standard V4.4 (128-bit) User Access : (none) Creator : Excel Producer : Mac OS X 10.12.6 Quartz PDFContext XMP Toolkit : Adobe XMP Core 5.4-c006 80.159825, 2016/09/16-03:31:08 Format : application/pdf Creator Tool : Excel```
comments:
I can reproduce this issue both with my browser.

```
Name 	    Firefox
Version 	62.0.3
Build ID 	20181010001701
User Agent 	Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64; rv:62.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/62.0
OS 	        Linux 4.14.98

var pdfjsVersion = '2.0.625';
var pdfjsBuild = 'e8b50883';
```

and with master at https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/commit/ece6a31a442d8d2489817579dfc57ed371135d3a (on the same browser obviously).
This looks like another case where PR #6606 might help.

@Snuffleupagus well, it may be linked, but this issue looks different than #6606 because lines get wider as you zoom out on the page. Ratios are not preserved when zooming in and out.

When you zoom out too much, the table turns into a big black rectangle. To me it looks more like an issue with the encoding picked by excel for the borders.
